In the foreground left, a person wears a voluminous, textured black wig (resembling a beehive or bouffant style). In the background center, a man with a beard wears a dark, curly wig and a suit. On the right, a person is seen in profile wearing a bright orange/red wig. The setting appears to be an indoor venue with warm, yellow ambient lighting.
